target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Current Kew accepts S. laciniatum as Texas-native, but the Hays/Purola record is explicitly an introduced planting and is not counted. Three exact target-zone native counties were not locked in this pass.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: No three exact target-zone native counties locked.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not count cultivated or introduced prairie-restoration plantings as native county occurrence.

morphology.look_here_first: Compass plant is unmistakable when mature: a tall perennial with huge basal leaves deeply cut almost to the midrib into narrow lobes, often oriented roughly north-south, and tall yellow flower stalks.
